name: localcoffeeshop-frontend
description: Frontend for Local Coffee Shop directory

scripts.build: npm run build:config && npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:html
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p public/dist && npx terser public/frontend.js -o public/dist/app.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/enums.js -o public/dist/enums.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/skeleton.js -o public/dist/skeleton.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/api-client.js -o public/dist/api-client.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/store.js -o public/dist/store.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/service-worker-registration.js -o public/dist/service-worker-registration.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/connection-banner.js -o public/dist/connection-banner.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/html/state.js -o public/dist/state.min.js -c -m
scripts.build:css: npx clean-css-cli -o public/dist/styles.min.css styles.css public/styles/about.css public/styles/common.css public/styles/features.css public/styles/home.css public/styles/states.css
